title: Configuration of the system by environment variable (NFR-12, ES-01, AR-12)
description: One property per environment variable. `required` lists the variables with no default in production; the backend refuses to start when one is missing. Secrets are listed in project/00_setup/secrets.env.example. Defaults for test and local come from the Spring profile `local` and from docker-compose.yml, never from code.

DB_PASSWORD.description: Database password. Secret. backend and the database image.

FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID.description: Expected issuer and audience of ID tokens (SR-01); also read by the web app. `demo-contacts` for the emulator.

FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY.description: Web app key of the Firebase project; `fake-api-key` with the emulator. Secret-like, listed in secrets.env.example. frontend container.

FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN.description: Auth domain of the Firebase project. frontend container.

FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST.description: host:port of the Authentication Emulator; accepts its unsigned tokens in the backend. Must be empty in production.

FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_URL.description: URL of the emulator as the browser reaches it. frontend container; empty in production.

TRASH_CLEANUP_CRON.description: Spring six-field cron of the trash cleanup (AR-10); at least once a day (BR-04).

RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Requests per user and minute (SR-09, R-017-08).

SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE.description: `local` only on a developer machine; never in production.
